summary.tldr: Prevents federal rules from requiring COVID-19 vaccination for some jobs and from stopping travel by plane, train, or ship solely because a person is not vaccinated.
what_it_does: Bars the Treasury Board from making COVID-19 vaccination a condition of employment in the federal public administration, or from suspending, reducing pay, or ending employment solely for not being vaccinated.
Bars new regulations under the Canada Labour Code from requiring COVID-19 vaccination as a job condition for work in or connected to a federal work, undertaking, or business.
Bars COVID-19 rules under the Aeronautics Act from preventing a person from boarding an aircraft solely because they have not received a COVID-19 vaccine.
Bars COVID-19 rules under the Railway Safety Act from preventing a person from boarding railway equipment solely because they have not received a COVID-19 vaccine.
Bars COVID-19 regulations under the Canada Shipping Act, 2001 from preventing a person from boarding a vessel solely because they have not received a COVID-19 vaccine.
summary.background: The bill amends the Financial Administration Act, the Canada Labour Code, the Aeronautics Act, the Railway Safety Act, and the Canada Shipping Act, 2001.
